ob.signinTagline: Everything around the training — the plan, the loads, the rest, the pace. You just lift.
ob.healthSub: I read heart rate, calories and distance for your runs and walks, so the cardio side is as complete as the lifting.
ob.bodySub: With these I know where to start you — the loads that athletes built like you actually lift.
ob.trainSub: Experience only sets the starting point. From there I take you as far as you can go.

calibration.framing: The first few workouts are for me to learn you. Weights start light — that's deliberate.

workout.reasonIncrease: Up {{delta}} from last time. You earned it.

workout.setSaveFailed: That set did not save. Complete it again.
workout.finishFailed: That did not finish. Your completed sets are saved.

finishSheet.body: Everything you have done so far is saved, and counts toward the next program I build for you.
finishSheet.title: End the workout here?

reasonSheet.increase: Your last three top sets moved faster than the weight on the bar. That's room to grow.
reasonSheet._comment_holdDecrease: Verbatim sheet sentences for hold/decrease not quoted in spec — reusing the one-line cause (not invented). Pending sign-off (content gap).

reasonSheet.decrease: Down {{delta}} today. Three hard sessions in a row — this is the smart move.

whyLoad.learning: From next week I match the loads and the reps to you precisely.
whyLoad.lineUp: Your last sessions cleared the top of the range here, so I moved the load up {{delta}} {{unit}}.
whyLoad.lineDown: Your recent sets came in under range, so I matched the load to what you're lifting clean — and kept every set.
whyLoad.lineHold: Right on target — strong, but I held the load until the signal is clean.
whyLoad.note: I never move a load on a single session. I read the pattern, then act — your job is just to lift.
whyLoad.learningTitle: A week of getting to know each other.

complete.notStartedBody: No exercises completed. Nothing was saved — start again whenever you're ready.

milestones.firstRaiseSub: I moved your load up. Earned, not scheduled.

load.remembered: We'll remember this weight next time

firstGym.title: We are learning each other
firstGym.body1: The first workouts are for the two of us: you learn how to work with me during a session, and I learn to match the load, the reps and the equipment in your gym.
firstGym.body2: I may not be exact at the start. Very quickly I will have everything I need to take you to your next level.

portrait.lockedBody: I'm learning how your body moves. {{remaining}} more sessions and I'll show you what I see.
portrait.headline: What your body can do
portrait.insightStrongest: I'm building around your {{pattern}}. It's your strongest.
portrait.compareProof: Your {{capability}} went from your weakest to {{state}}.

swap.title: Swap exercise
swap.body: The same movement, a different station. Your progression comes with you.

report.title: Your progress
report.subtitle: Your strongest lifts, then and now.
report.empty: Strength is the one thing that only shows up in the looking back. Train, and I will show you how far you came.
report.startingPointSub: This is where you begin. Every gain from here is measured against it.
report.workingAt: Working at {{value}} {{unit}} — I've met you where you are.

progressReps.text: {{ex}} is near the top of its range, so I added a rep per set.
progressReps.observation: {{ex}} is improving and close to the top of its range.
progressReps.conclusion: Another rep per set comes before more weight.
progressReps.action: I set the target to {{reps}} reps.

progressLoad.text: {{ex}} hit the top of its range with room, so I added {{delta}} kg.
progressLoad.textVariation: {{ex}} is holding the top of its range — keep it there and the harder variation comes next.
progressLoad.observation: {{ex}} reached the top of its range with room to spare.
progressLoad.conclusion: It is ready for more weight.
progressLoad.conclusionVariation: Holding the top consistently earns the harder variation.
progressLoad.actionVariation: I kept the target at the top of the range.

graduate.text: You outgrew {{from}}, so I moved you up to {{ex}}.
graduate.observation: {{from}} has sat at the top of its range for weeks.
graduate.conclusion: You outgrew it — the harder variation is the next step.

reprice.text: Last week {{ex}} came in under its prescription, so I set it to {{load}} kg and kept your sets unchanged.
reprice.textBw: Last week {{ex}} came in under its prescription, so I matched it to your demonstrated capability and kept your sets unchanged.
reprice.observation: Last week {{ex}} came in under its prescription.
reprice.conclusion: That shows me the right weight for now.
reprice.action: I set it to {{load}} kg and kept your sets unchanged.
reprice.actionBw: I matched it to your demonstrated capability and kept your sets unchanged.

leverVol.text: {{ex}} held steady, so I added a set for more stimulus.
leverVol.conclusion: More sets give it more stimulus.

leverLoad.text: {{ex}} stalled with full volume, so I added {{delta}} kg to break it.
leverLoad.textStep: {{ex}} stalled with full volume, so I stepped the load up to break it.
leverLoad.observation: {{ex}} stalled with its full volume in place.
leverLoad.conclusion: A small load increase breaks the stall.

leverRange.text: {{ex}} stalled with full volume, so I changed the range to {{lo}} to {{hi}} and kept the lift.
leverRange.observation: {{ex}} stalled with its full volume in place.
leverRange.conclusion: A new rep range keeps the same lift moving.
leverRange.action: I set the range to {{lo}} to {{hi}}.

patientHold.text: {{ex}} is steady, so I hold it and re-test before pushing.
patientHold.conclusion: I hold and re-test before pushing.
patientHold.action: I hold this week and probe a small increase soon.

swap.text: That slot missed the mark for a few weeks while your other lifts held, so I swapped it to {{ex}}.
swap.observation: That slot has missed the mark for a few weeks while your other lifts held.
swap.conclusion: The exercise is the thing to change.

deload.text: I pulled the weight and volume back so you can keep training safely.
deload.observation: You flagged something to train around.
deload.conclusion: I pull the weight and volume back so you can train safely.
deload.action: I eased it to {{load}} kg and {{sets}} sets.
deload.actionBw: I eased it to bodyweight and {{sets}} sets.

absence.text: After more than a week away, I eased the load about ten percent and we rebuild.
absence.observation: More than a week passed without training.
absence.conclusion: I ease back in to rebuild safely.
absence.action: I eased about ten percent to {{load}} kg.

adherenceHold.observation: Last week did not fully happen.
